about: Sources behind the AEO skill. The per-source detail gathered while building this skill is not redistributed; this list links to the originals.
numbering: n is the citation number in source_documents/AI-Era_SEO_AEO_Documentation_Guide.md (Works cited), so a citation such as [5] in the guide is entry n=5. Entry 68 was read during the build but is not cited by the guide. The build roadmap (knowledge/url_extraction_roadmap.json) numbers records 1-39 the same way; its records 40-67 were different pages, listed under roadmap_only.
summaries: Each summary is our own one-sentence description of what the source covers. Figures and wording from the sources are not reproduced.
